title: The golden workbook contains a text label that is absent from the input and that nothing in the prompt asks for, inside a compared range, so a correct solution cannot match it.
evidence: Golden 'P&L'!A13='Esc. %'; input 'P&L'!A13 is empty. 'P&L'!A2:Q35 is in answer_position, and the task passes only if every compared cell matches.
confirmation: Golden 'P&L'!A13 = 'Esc. %' while the input A13 is empty, and nothing in the prompt asks for the column header. Since the cell differs from input to golden, it is a modification cell that must match exactly, so a solution doing every requested step fails it.
